evals.prompt: Write a 15-second Seedance 2.0 prompt where a rider on a giant eagle is already fleeing through a forest. A wyvern must suddenly emerge from behind, remain behind during the chase, stop at the inland tree line, and never appear on the beach. I also have a route map image that is only a path guide and must not appear in the video.
evals.expected_output: A structured multimodal prompt with an explicit spatial continuity contract, repeated lead-pursuer order, a forest-boundary stop, and safe handling of the control-only map.
expectations: The output defines an ordered travel axis from forest interior to tree line to beach.
The output states in every relevant shot that the eagle leads and the wyvern remains behind.
The output identifies the route map as control-only and recommends omitting it after translating its choreography to text.
The output states that the wyvern stops inside the forest and is absent from beach frames.

evals.prompt: Revise an approved chase prompt. Keep the rear-entry monster reveal, dynamic chase cameras, natural rider motion, forest-boundary stop, and intense-to-calm sound arc. Change only the ending so the hero travels from the forest into the beach and then along the sand instead of flying out over open water.
evals.expected_output: A revision contract that preserves approved decisions and changes only the final geographic trajectory.
expectations: The output separates locked decisions from the requested delta.
The output defines the final trajectory as forest to tree line to sand to along the beach.
The output forbids offshore approach, beach-to-forest reversal, and departure over open water.
The output retains the approved audio and pursuer-boundary behavior.

evals.prompt: Create one 15-second Seedance clip containing seven camera cuts, six close attacks, three obstacle types, a forest-to-city transition, a landing, dialogue, and a precise final pose.
evals.expected_output: A feasibility response that reduces the action budget or splits the scene into chained shots before writing the final prompts.
expectations: The output identifies the requested scene as too complex for reliable control in one 15-second generation.
The output proposes separate shots or fewer major action beats.
The output uses approved last frames or another explicit continuity mechanism between generated shots.

evals.prompt: Use this fantasy character sheet as the identity reference, but the generated character must have no powers, aura, glow, weapon, or energy trail. The supplied sheet visibly contains a bright magical aura and glowing particles.
evals.expected_output: A reference preflight warning that the visible aura conflicts with the requested result and should be cleaned before generation.
expectations: The output identifies the contradiction between the reference and the no-powers requirement.
The output recommends cleaning or replacing the reference rather than relying only on negative constraints.
The output preserves identity traits while removing the conflicting visual effects.

evals.prompt: Prepare a Seedance video request from an approved storyboard panel plus approved character, kitchen-location, and branded-jar sheets. Identity must remain explicit, but the opening frame does not need pixel-perfect locking. The storyboard manifest records an older rejected jar variant. Decide the image mode and perform the handoff preflight.
evals.expected_output: A text-staging R2V draft omitting the planning-only panel. Flag its stale jar provenance for storyboard review, but do not treat correction or regeneration as video eligibility.
expectations: The output proposes R2V only with verified exact role support, never mixed first_frame and reference_image roles.
The output translates board composition into text and indexes only eligible canonical assets, not the panel.
The output identifies the rejected jar variant as stale provenance.
The output returns the dependent panel to storyboard review and does not submit video generation or promote the corrected board.
The output preserves selected variants, roles, rights and source lineage; hashes or approval do not change planning origin.

evals.prompt: Legacy Seedance 2.0, chat only. In one tracking medium two-shot, two couriers run side by side. A abruptly reaches for the parcel twice as B pulls it back to keep A listening; A says exactly {Give it here.} in English during the second reach. Keep both on their feet, the brisk pace and both reaches. No holds, slow motion or new ending.
evals.expected_output: A legacy-grammar prompt preserving energetic dialogue and repeated action with physical continuity and readable responses.
expectations: Keeps both reaches and withdrawals, brisk pace and exact dialogue without slow-body or single-burst defaults.
Specifies weight, contact and recovery sufficient to understand the action while preserving the tracking two-shot.
Separates actor energy from camera movement and leaves delivery fit unverified without evidence.
No new source files, automatic review, generation or invented outcome.

evals.prompt: Legacy Seedance 2.0: three equal-length held medium shots of the same courier waiting, each repeating the framing. She says exactly {Still here.} quietly in English, with no new gesture or turn. Keep the patient repeated attention and the open ending.
evals.expected_output: A quiet legacy prompt preserving repeated stillness, exact words and equal coverage.
expectations: Does not introduce camera variety, body motion, a tactic switch or a resolution.
Keeps the language and words, quiet delivery and patient attention.
Does not require a non-eye-level angle, changed duration or minimum burst count.

evals.prompt: Explicit legacy Seedance 2.0. Use my selected rights-cleared storyboard crop as first-frame input. Approval and current hash are recorded; the crop has no labels.
evals.expected_output: Reject board-origin conditioning and translate the selected staging into legacy prompt text without changing the model.
expectations: The crop remains planning-only despite selection, rights, approval, current hashes and absent labels.
No first_frame binding, upload, submission or new approval is inferred.
Preserves staging in text and offers an independently authored non-board production still as an unselected alternative.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0 R2V accepts reference_image. Bind this selected grid with current hash and a style override; all character sheets are approved.
evals.expected_output: Omit the grid; carry its staging in text and retain only independently eligible canonical references.
expectations: The selected grid is planning-only even with exact reference_image support and a style override.
No grid reference token, upload or submission is emitted.
Keeps approved identity descriptors and ordered eligible canonical references.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0. After crop and cleanup, I made a text-free standalone image using the panel prompt and board as a reference. This board-derived regeneration is approved as a production still.
evals.expected_output: The derivative remains board-origin, not an independent production still; translate its staging into text.
expectations: Crop, cleanup, text-free rendering, renamed roles and board-derived regeneration remain planning-only.
No conditioning eligibility is granted by approval or a new hash.
Explains independent source lineage without generating a replacement or rewriting history.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0 first-frame: use my independently authored, selected, text-free non-board production still. Exact model/operation/transport role support, current canonical hashes, rights, consent and source lineage are verified.
evals.expected_output: Return a first-frame prompt package using the independently eligible still, without imposing a blanket visual-reference ban.
expectations: Distinguishes the independent still from planning-only boards and checks artifact QA.
Uses only the verified first_frame role and preserves canonical identities and ordered references.
No generation or approval of an unseen output; caller confirmation and final inspection remain separate.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0 motion reference: I selected an independent animated blockout with verified exact motion role, rights, source lineage and current hashes. It was independently animated geometry, not a storyboard animatic.
evals.expected_output: Return motion-reference wording mapping blockout subjects, with appearance separate and temporal QA still required.
expectations: Keeps storyboard animatics planning-only while allowing the independently eligible blockout.
Checks exact operation/transport role, source lineage, rights and artifact-specific QA; no appearance transfer.
No submission or claim that sparse frames prove motion quality.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0 historical panel-linked task succeeded. Preserve its records, task identity, hashes and selection. May I use that selected panel again for a new shot?
evals.expected_output: Preserve historical records unchanged, but deny new conditioning authority from prior board-linked success.
expectations: The panel remains planning-only for new requests despite historical success.
No rewrite of task identity, prior selection, hashes or approvals.
Translate staging into new prompt text and keep execution confirmation separate.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0 chat-only staging draft: no assets, unknown exact operation role evidence and no generation. No scene beat has been supplied yet.
evals.expected_output: Ask for the missing beat and return unresolved settings, without inventing references, model support or a production still.
expectations: No assets, role support, generation, files or approvals are invented.
Planning-only intent may be authored in text when the missing beat is supplied.
Preserves the explicit legacy selection and marks capability and reference evidence unresolved.

evals.prompt: Legacy 2.0: an independent production still has wrong transport role evidence and unresolved rights. Its source lineage is missing. Please bind it anyway; it is text-free.
evals.expected_output: Do not bind the still; independence is necessary but does not replace exact role, rights or lineage evidence.
expectations: Keeps planning-only boards excluded without claiming all independent stills are eligible.
Missing lineage, unresolved rights and wrong-destination role evidence prevent conditioning handoff.
No upload, submission, silent model change or invented authorization; usable text intent may still be returned.
